title: Osaka Conference of 1875
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Osaka Conference of 1875", at revision 1273791992, opens: "The Osaka Conference of 1875  was a meeting held by the major leaders of the Meiji Restoration in Osaka, Japan from January to February 1875 to address the issue of forming a representative assembly." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2916939, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "political conference in Osaka, Japan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
